title: Compliance Milestones Dashboard and Risk Mitigation Playbook
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Build an operational dashboard + an actionable playbook that tracks progress and residual risk across SOC2 and ISO27001 readiness, SSO/SAML rollout, and audit-log delivery. The dashboard should be the single source of truth for program stakeholders (Product, Security, Engineering, Legal) and surface blockers, owners, and remediation ETA. The playbook will document runbooks for: emergency evidence collection, audit-ready log extraction, SSO tenant onboarding checklist, and how to triage control failures. Deliverables: (1) internal dashboard with milestone rows and risk score, (2) a living playbook in Confluence with step-by-step runbooks and contact matrix, (3) linked Linear tickets for all remediation tasks with SLAs, (4) one internal readiness dry-run and list of outstanding gaps, (5) handoff package for external auditors.

acceptance_criteria: Dashboard displays live status for each milestone with owner, % complete, blocker flag, and next action
Playbook contains documented runbooks for evidence collection, SSO tenant onboarding, and audit log extraction with sample queries
All P0 control gaps either remediated or covered by compensating controls documented in Confluence
Dry-run produces a gap list <= 10 items with owners and SLAs assigned
Exportable artifact bundle available (PDF + CSV + log sample) for external auditors
notes: 2026-02-12: Project kickoff with Security, Engineering, Legal. Agreed to 6 milestone cadence and weekly syncs.

2026-03-02: Engineering implementation choices: prefer OIDC-first flow for SSO, but SAML shim required for enterprise tenants. Trade-off: extra engineering effort vs. faster tenant compatibility.

risks: SSO compatibility: Some enterprise customers require SAML-only flows; building a full SAML bridge adds ~2 sprint cost
Audit log completeness: Current runtime emits events at 3 hop points; missing early ingress events for private deployments
Resource constraints: Dedicated security engineering capacity limited in Cycle 12; may delay remediation
External auditor availability: certification vendors booking dates in May-June; missing internal readiness could push to Q3
decision_log: 2026-02-20: Decided to prioritize SSO/OIDC path for new customers and implement a SAML compatibility shim for legacy tenants (decision by PM + Eng + Security).
2026-03-03: Agreed on 90-day retention default for audit logs with option-based longer retention for enterprise customers (legal counsel approved).
2026-03-09: Chose to centralize evidence exports in a single artifact capture tool to avoid ad-hoc requests during audits.
